title: Tôi có nên uống thuốc này cùng với đồ ăn không?
englishTitle: Should I take it with food?
pronunciation: Toi co nen uong thuoc nay cung voi do an khong
summary: Use this at a pharmacy when the label is unclear and timing matters.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask before the first dose, especially if the medicine may upset your stomach or needs a meal.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Hold up the packet or bottle while you ask. Let the pharmacist answer before adding symptoms or timing details.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi có nên asks should I; uống thuốc này means take this medicine; cùng với đồ ăn means with food.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Keep doctor, pharmacy, and nearest-pharmacy phrases nearby if the answer turns into a bigger health errand.

phrases.pronunciation: nya thoo-ok gun nyut uh dow

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Best at the pharmacy counter or after a clinic visit. Show the packet so the staff can talk about this medicine, not medicine in general.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Food, water, and timing instructions matter. If the answer includes morning, evening, before food, or after food, ask them to point or write it.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: These cover symptoms and medicine needs if the pharmacist asks why you need it.
